questions.question: What is the theme of Jeremiah 30?
options: A long list of all of the kings who had ruled over Judah
The promise to restore the fortunes of Israel and Judah
The final and complete judgment upon the city of Babylon
An urgent call to march out together against the enemy
questions.answer: The promise to restore the fortunes of Israel and Judah

questions.question: What did God command Jeremiah to do with the words of restoration?
options: Sing them aloud in the temple courts
Seal them away until the exile ended
Speak them only to the king

questions.question: Jeremiah 30 promises that though the people's wound seems incurable, God will restore health and heal them.
The days are coming when I will restore My people Israel and Judah from _____.
You shall be my people, and I will be your _____.
